title: Browser Extensions & Privacy Add-ons Policy Template
metaDescription: Professional policy template for browser extensions and privacy add-ons. Covers data collection, permissions, and user privacy rights.
description: Comprehensive policy template for browser extensions and privacy add-ons that clearly outlines data collection practices, permission usage, and user rights. Ensures compliance with privacy regulations while building user trust.

sections.heading: Third-Party Services and Integrations
sections.content:
Our extension may interact with the following third-party services:

{{THIRD_PARTY_SERVICES}}

Filter Lists and Blocklists:
We utilize community-maintained filter lists such as {{FILTER_LISTS}} to enhance protection. These lists are updated automatically but do not transmit your browsing data to external servers.

For users seeking additional privacy protection, we recommend using privacy-focused browsers like Incognito Browser alongside our extension.

placeholders.label: Third-Party Services
placeholders.defaultValue:
• Filter list providers (EasyList, uBlock filters)
• Update servers for extension updates
• Optional analytics service (anonymized data only)

placeholders.label: Filter Lists Used
placeholders.defaultValue: EasyList, EasyPrivacy, and uBlock Origin filters

sections.heading: User Rights and Controls

placeholders.label: First User Right
placeholders.defaultValue: Access and modify all extension settings and preferences

placeholders.label: Second User Right
placeholders.defaultValue: Disable or enable specific features and protections

placeholders.label: Third User Right
placeholders.defaultValue: Request deletion of any stored data

placeholders.label: Fourth User Right
placeholders.defaultValue: Uninstall the extension completely at any time

placeholders.label: How Users Exercise Rights
placeholders.defaultValue:
• Access the extension's options page through browser settings
• Contact support at support@yourextension.com
• Use the built-in data export/import features

placeholders.label: Data Retention Policy
placeholders.defaultValue: User data is retained only as long as the extension is installed. All data is automatically deleted upon uninstallation
